rows.en: The UCMA is performing better than expected…

Mm…

I never imagined they would go this far, either.
They're using a snack bar run by a man named Tobei Tachibana as their base, I was told?
As long as they fight these organizations without troubling us, there's no problem, but…

Director…

Isn't it time we joined the fight in earnest ourselves, and kept these problems from surfacing by controlling things from the inside?

Mm…

But the principle of the Terrestrial Defense Force must remain strictly defense only… We cannot arm ourselves, stand on the front line and go around brandishing weapons!
But, Director… even so, we can't just leave things as they are, can we?
I know that! I have a good idea. Call Captain Kiriyama!

And so…

from now on, the Ultra Garrison, cooperating with the Science Patrol and MAT, is authorized to use armed force against any external enemy when necessary, not just in self-defense.

So what you're saying is…

from now on we can go bang-bang against any enemy without holding back?

Well, yes…

But as the aces of the TDF, we must act with awareness and responsibility, so that we have nothing to be ashamed of!
Leave it to us!
Let's let Mr. Tachibana and the others know too!
Mm… Anne, you pass it on to them! I'm counting on you!
Yes, sir…

By the way, it seems a huge object has fallen near the Kiso Valley…

It was reported by a child, so it's not reliable… but I want it checked out just in case. Furuhashi, Soga, go investigate!
Yes, sir!

Hey!! Out of the way, out of the way!

We've got no time to deal with hitchhikers!
Get out of the way already, you!
Clear the road!
Can't be helped… Go on, give him a taste of it!
Right…
Ha ha ha ha…
Ha ha ha ha…
Now, let's get going!
That's weird? Hey, rev it harder!
It's no good…
Ha ha ha…

…!?

Hey, you! If you get in our way, you'll be sorry!
Why, you!!
Get in your way? Not at all! Quite the opposite, Soga.
What…!? How do you know my name?
I also know that you're Furuhashi, the strongest man in the whole Defense Force.
…!? Do you want something from us?
I've been waiting here all this time because I wanted to save your lives.
Save our lives…!?
You…? Ha ha ha…
This is no laughing matter! If you value your lives, you must not go any farther!
Do you think we could carry out the Ultra Garrison's duties if we valued our lives? Who on earth are you?
Just a drifter, as you can see.
What's your name?

My name?

Let's see… Let's just call me "Dan Moroboshi".
Dan Moroboshi?
This is Furuhashi! HQ, respond! HQ, respond!
What is it? What happened?
It's a kaiju! A kaiju has appeared in the lake!
Right, we'll head out to support you at once! Furuhashi, Soga! Be very careful out there!

Missile Gecko! The day of Plan D18, when we blow up the oil refineries of the Keihin district, is near…

It must succeed no matter what! First, put your power to the test!
Uhyooo, uhyooo!!

How's that? How do you like the power of my missiles! Uhyooo, uhyooo!!

…!?
What's that… thing? It looks like it's attacking the factory.
Hey, stupid! Keep your mouth shut!
Who's there? You saw it, didn't you? Destron's secret…
We don't know nothin'! We didn't see a thing!
Grr… I'll kill you! Uhyooo, uhyooo!!
Hold it!!
So you've come, Shiro Kazami!
So it really was you Destron scum destroying the factories!? Toh!!
Shut up! Silence!!
Now, hurry and run!
I'm Misao… and this kid's Hiroshi! I owe you one, handsome!
Furuhashi…!?
Soga…!?
Hey, are you all right!? Hey…
Waaaaagh!!

Grr… Curse you, Rider V3!

But I've got the woman and the kid!! If you want them back, come to our hideout! Uhyooo, uhyooo!!
Ultra Hawk 1, launch!!
Furuhashi! Investigate that huge object that fell! Soga, cover Furuhashi!
I'll fight back with a Capsule Monster! Miclas, I'm counting on you!!
Another kaiju has appeared!
A kaiju…? But something's off about it! That kaiju may be on our side.
…Has it hit its limit? Miclas, return!!
Ugh… Miclas… return…
What are these things?
Eleking!! Look out! Run, Eleking!!
So this is the object that fell?
Furuhashi…
You again? What are you doing here?

uncertain: U06981: speaker Chief of Staff Takenaka; 各組織 rendered "these organizations" (the evil organizations).
U06990: 立花さんたち rendered "Mr. Tachibana and the others".
U06999: おみまいしてやれ — Furuhashi telling Soga to give the hitchhiker a scare (horn/engine); kept vague as "give him a taste of it".
U07004: おかしいな? translated as "That's weird?" to keep the puzzled tone; the car will not move.
U07043: 君 — Furuhashi checking on someone unnamed (likely Dan); rendered "Hey".
U07045: Missile Gecko calls Shiro "Rider V3" though Riderman has just cried out; kept as written.
